question: Manish Desai was in the news for taking charge of which post in the Press Information Bureau in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Principal Director General**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manish Desai was appointed as the **Principal Director General** of the Press Information Bureau in September 2023.
 
• Desai has a distinguished career in the Indian Information Service, having held various important positions.
 
• The Press Information Bureau (PIB) is the nodal agency of the Government of India responsible for disseminating information to the print and electronic media on government policies, programs, initiatives, and achievements.
 
• The Principal Director General is the head of the PIB and plays a crucial role in coordinating the information dissemination activities of the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Press Information Bureau was established in 1919 and operates under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• PIB also organizes press conferences, interviews, and press tours for journalists to provide firsthand information about government activities.
 
• It has a network of offices across India to ensure effective communication and outreach.
 
• Manish Desai's appointment is expected to further enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the PIB.
